snap_resource_limit.statement: The Indiana SNAP resource limit is $5,000 for households under BBCE (broad-based categorical eligibility). The $3,000 and $4,750 figures are the federal defaults; they are NOT the Indiana limit and must not be presented as the limit for an Indiana SNAP household. A one-time lump sum (a settlement, for example) is not SNAP income; it counts as a resource in the month received.
